text:
linh phan: quick sync on int4: customers want cost wins but our canaries showed a few models with surprisingly bad drop offs. we need a safer gating + preview flow.
omar d: agreed. my proposal: introduce a per-profile "quality escrow" bucket that collects daily validation deltas. only when escrow balance is positive can the runtime use aggressive slots like int4.
nora k: explain escrow?
omar d: think of escrow as a moving score. profiles deposit a small amount of validation credit when they pass tests; consuming aggressive quantizations withdraws credit proportional to observed regression. if escrow < threshold, int4 is disabled for that model.
tyler b: nice. operationally we need two surfaces:
- developer preview endpoint that runs a cheap sampled validation set and returns an escrow delta
- runtime header knobs for customers (tier or explicit profile id)
linh phan: preview sketch:
```
POST /v1/precision/preview
{ model: "rw-14b", profile: "balanced-v2", budget_samples: 50 }
-> { escrow_delta: -0.04, sample_summary: [ {id: "s1", metric: "rouge", delta: -0.01}, ... ], can_use_int4: false }
```
omar d: important: preview should not return full outputs by default (privacy + cost). provide option `return_samples=true` for internal debugging. aggregated metrics only by default.
nora k: runtime fallback semantics? we need deterministic and observable behavior. propose: 1) try declared profile (weight-only fp8/int8 if available), 2) if runtime OOM or perf error -> step down to next allowed precision, 3) if stepped down, increment escrow penalty and emit `X-Redwood-Precision-Event: fallback=int4` header.
tyler b: small nit: ordering should be configurable per-profile. some customers prefer fp16 fallback rather than int4. profiles should carry `fallback_policy: ["fp8","int8","fp16","int4"]` field.
linh phan: agree—profiles must be authoritative. default fallback we ship: [fp8,int8,fp16,int4] but allow opt-out for int4.
omar d: telemetry items to capture:
- profile_id
- precision_selected (actual used)
- fallback_chain (list of attempted precisions)
- escrow_change (numeric)
- sample_version (which validation snapshot used)
- canary_fraction (if in canary)
ops-bot: alert: validation-escrow fell below threshold for model rw-14b on profile balanced-v2. created ticket RW-9002.
nora k: about canaries: rollout plan should be controlled via canary fraction + escrow requirement. e.g. enable int4 for 0.5% of traffic only if preview escrow_delta > -0.02 and daily regression < 0.03.
tyler b: cost/latency prediction: console should estimate expected savings and risk band. show a mini-sparkline of recent escrow deltas next to the enable toggle.
linh phan: SDK header proposal:
```
// simple tier
X-Redwood-Precision-Tier: eco|default|premium
// explicit profile
X-Redwood-Precision-Profile: tenant:profile-id
// preview header
X-Redwood-Precision-DryRun: true
```
omar d: also include `X-Redwood-Preview-Sample-Seed` for deterministic preview runs. helps debugging flaky regressions.
ops-bot: info: ran escrow snapshot for balanced-v2: balance=0.12, last_delta=-0.01.
nora k: edge cases: model adapters or LoRA often change sensitivity to quant. profiles must include `compatibility: ["base", "lora"]` and preview should allow `context_variant` param.
linh phan: rollout automation idea: when promoting a profile we run a validation matrix (models x datasets x adapters) before canary. must record which matrix was used as `sample_version` in telemetry.
tyler b: about storage: profiles as immutable records with semantic ids like `balanced-v2@2026-03-01`. UI shows change log and rollback button.
omar d: security/SLAs: enterprise tenants can opt to lock to a fixed `precision_allowed` list. runtime enforces this by rejecting any profile that would attempt disallowed precision.
ops-bot: automated-scan: detected new profile candidate eco-experimental-v1 pending canary. run preview? (y/n)
linh phan: action items:
- omar: implement escrow math and preview API (spike this week)
- nora: add telemetry fields to schema + dashboard mocks
- tyler: profile storage immutability + rollback UI
- linH: write short RFC and decision log
tyler b: can someone add a short blurb in the ops playbook about how to interpret escrow deltas? I can add a UI tooltip but ops need runbook steps.
linh phan: will draft playbook note. thanks all.
